_comment: Tailoring-enzyme family registry (VGP-399 card 2/3). data-driven: adding a family is data, not code. `tags` are EXACT sec_met_domain names verified present in this project's real antiSMASH region GBKs (survey 2026-09-01, initial 400-GBK sample, extended 2026-09-01 by a FULL-cohort survey of 16,049 region GBKs in the project corpus); counts in `_seen`. Exact-tag matching only — substring matching replicates the ks_phylogeny 'pks' bug. length_window = whole-CDS aa sanity bounds (fragment/fusion flags, not biology police). Claim-safety: family membership = capacity context (diagnostic-gene-capacity-not-identity), never a modification claim.

halogenase.notes: flavin-dependent tryptophan halogenases; Flavoprotein (PF01494) is halogenase CONTEXT, not membership

glycosyltransferase.notes: GT-A/GT-B sugar-transfer tailoring incl. macrolide GTs (MGT)

methyltransferase.notes: O-/N-/C-methyltransferases; RiPP MT-RREs kept as their own tag

sugar_aminotransferase.notes: PLP-dependent aminotransferases incl. the DegT/DnrJ/EryC1 deoxysugar family — the saccharide-reality-check counterexample class (real deoxysugar tailoring vs housekeeping)

prenyltransferase.notes: prenyl-transfer tailoring; PT_phytoene_like deliberately EXCLUDED (phytoene/squalene synthase = terpene CORE, not tailoring)

deoxysugar_reductase.notes: dTDP-sugar reductase/epimerase family (RmlD-like) — deoxysugar pathway tailoring; pairs with sugar_aminotransferase + epimerase for the saccharide-reality-check read

radical_SAM.notes: radical-SAM tailoring (SPASM/twitch incl. TIGR04085 4Fe-4S-binding); RiPP-adjacent but distinct from core maturation. Lant_dehydr_*/YcaO deliberately EXCLUDED — RiPP core maturation is the UMED scan's territory, not tailoring
